## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 16-juan late-Míng Chán anthology whose title — "Transmission Outside the Teaching" — invokes the standard Chán slogan (教外別傳，不立文字, "A transmission outside the scriptures; not dependent on words"). Compiled by Lí Méi together with other late-Míng monastic editors; emphasises the teaching-dialogues of the orthodox Línjì and Cáodòng lines.

**Abstract**

One of the late-Míng Chán anthology compilations that flourished alongside the *Zhǐyuè lù* of [Qú Rǔjī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9E%BF%E6%B1%9D%E7%A8%B7) ([KR6q0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0023)) — the late sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries saw substantial lay and monastic interest in curated Chán readers, and the *Jiàowài biéchuán* is a representative exemplar. The compilation draws from the Sòng lamp records and from early-Míng recorded-sayings, selecting for pedagogical value rather than genealogical completeness.
